categories.label: I/O blocks (on the machine)
categories.what: Fixed channels in one sealed housing with M12 ports.

categories.label: I/O modules (in the cabinet)
categories.what: Fixed channels in one module with terminals, on a DIN rail.

categories.label: Modular I/O couplers
categories.what: The head of a row of I/O slices or modules; the channels depend on what is fitted.

categories.label: IO-Link masters
categories.what: Ports that speak IO-Link to sensors and actuators.

categories.label: Valve terminals
categories.what: Pneumatic valve manifolds and their bus nodes; an output switches a solenoid.

categories.label: Drives
categories.what: Frequency inverters, servo drives and their network option cards.

categories.label: Motor starters and protection
categories.what: Starters, soft starters and motor management relays.

categories.label: Power meters
categories.what: Meters that give voltage, current, power and energy.

categories.label: Vision sensors and code readers
categories.what: Cameras that inspect, and readers of 1D and 2D codes.

categories.label: Robots
categories.what: Robot controllers, as a device another controller reads and commands.

categories.label: Controllers
categories.what: Programmable controllers that also answer as a device.

categories.label: Sensors and actuators on a digital channel
categories.what: Wired to a point of an I/O block, not on the network; described from the IODD.
